title: Four personas
subtitle: STE Audit Management Tool · Functional Requirements v2.1

steps.heading: Preparer
body: Associate prepares work and evidence.

steps.heading: Reviewer
body: Senior / Manager independently reviews and resolves exceptions.

steps.heading: Approver
body: Partner authorizes acceptance, planning and final opinion.

steps.heading: Client
body: Coordinator / CFO submits PBC and receives released documents.

note: Preparer/Staff executes Green work, Senior/Reviewer executes Amber work and independently reviews eligible preparation, Manager executes Red/high-risk work and clears the current engagement review, and the assigned Partner approves planning, SRM and final release. Client finance uploads evidence; authorized management decides AJEs and supplies the signed LOR. User switching does not authenticate a person.

title: Flow 1 — Commercial to activation
subtitle: STE Audit Management Tool · Functional Requirements v2.1

steps.heading: Lead and proposal
body: Record intake, scope, team credentials and fee; dispatch by Email / WhatsApp (simulated).

steps.heading: Dual-Key gate
body: Commercial acceptance plus independent Partner professional clearance precede ISA 210 Engagement Letter and 50% advance invoice.

steps.heading: Settlement
body: Receipt and settlement activate the PBC portal.

note: Capture a valid entity and MD/CFO/liaison responsibilities. Present and dispatch the exact proposal revision; record client acceptance and independent assigned-Partner risk approval. Manager prepares a draft EL; assigned Partner signs and issues it with the actual reporting period and submission deadline. Record 50% advance once; receipt generation and simulated onboarding follow automatically. If file storage fails, show payment saved / receipt pending and retry without another payment.
review: Confirm this flow against executed evidence.

title: Module 1 — Commercial & CRM
subtitle: STE Audit Management Tool · Functional Requirements v2.1

steps.heading: Intake and profiles
body: Lead channels and client holding / subsidiary / affiliate profiles.

steps.heading: Proposal and letter
body: Terms, team credentials, dispatch and revision-bound acceptance.

steps.heading: Advance
body: 50% advance invoice, receipt and portal activation.

note: Phone, WhatsApp, Email, Web Form and Referral intake are supported. Brief quotation and comprehensive technical proposal retain firm profile, history, commercial registrations, team credentials, industry portfolio, methodology, fees and delivery timeline. Pin proposal ID, revision, client, service, period, currency and fee. Wrong-period, stale, withdrawn or foreign proposals must not issue an EL. MD receives proposals/reports, CFO receives invoices/receipts, and liaison receives PBC requests; missing or ambiguous routing blocks the handover.

title: Flow 2 — Governance to approved planning
subtitle: STE Audit Management Tool · Functional Requirements v2.1

steps.heading: Acceptance / Continuance
body: Track A mandatory controls; Track B six explicit answers with prior-period reference.

steps.heading: Ingest and schedule
body: PBC workspace, actual availability, leave and target utilization; import and map TB.

steps.heading: Partner planning
body: PM benchmark bands, TE 50–75%, SAD 3–5%, ±5% manager rounding; Partner approval pinned to current TB.

note: Assigned-Partner risk acceptance provisions the internal five-folder directory; advance receipt and simulated password reset separately activate client uploads. Import the TB, validate balance and source digest, approve mapping and record staffing/milestones. Select a current TB-derived benchmark and document any PBT normalization against a contributing account. Assigned Partner approval binds the plan to the source revision; replacement TB requires reconfirmation.

title: Module 2 — Governance & Planning
subtitle: STE Audit Management Tool · Functional Requirements v2.1

steps.heading: Directory and workspace
body: Engagement-scoped five-folder taxonomy; M365 provisioning simulated.

steps.heading: Resources and mapping
body: Resource scheduling and same-client eligible prior-period mapping memory.

steps.heading: Materiality
body: Shared UI/store validation and stale approval after TB changes.

note: Exact directory: 01_Administration & Planning; 02_Trial Balance & Schedules; 03_Fieldwork & Testing; 04_Drafts & Deliverables; 05_Final Signed Archive. Staffing captures Planning, Fieldwork, Review and Reporting, capacity, leave and dates; overlapping allocations cannot exceed capacity. Normalized PBT rate 5.0%–10.0%; revenue 0.5%–2.0%; assets 0.5%–1.0%; equity/net assets 1.0%–2.0%. TE is 50%–75% of PM; SAD is 3%–5%; Manager rounding stays within ±5%. Example PBT 1,068,420 at 5% gives PM 53,421 before optional rounding. Significant risks and critical estimates remain Red even at low balances.

title: Flow 3 — Fieldwork to SRM
subtitle: STE Audit Management Tool · Functional Requirements v2.1

steps.heading: Prepare
body: Split P&L / Balance Sheet dashboard and workprograms.

steps.heading: Execute
body: Sampling, evidence, Analytical Review and mandatory ISA 570 assessment.

steps.heading: Review
body: Independent Manager review; SRM summarizes AJEs, unadjusted differences and critical estimates.

note: Each applicable mapped FSLI opens its substantive program, independently from broad Analytical Review and Going Concern. Assertions are Ownership, Valuation, Completeness, Existence and Cut-off. Separate workpapers preserve distinct Sales/PPE preparation and review. Independent row edits merge across tabs; same-procedure conflicts demand explicit resolution. Current digital or physical evidence supports tested samples; Hybrid requires both. Rework invalidates stale clearance. Manager clearance generates a current SRM, with a visible retry if artifact generation fails.

title: Module 3 — Technical Fieldwork
subtitle: STE Audit Management Tool · Functional Requirements v2.1

steps.heading: Sampling
body: Random, Monetary Unit, Systematic Random and distinct Stratified Attribute methods; persisted reproducibility.

steps.heading: Confirmations
body: Critical confirmations block release; persisted Holding Letter never clears the blocker.

steps.heading: Evidence and SRM
body: Workpapers, findings, review notes and source revisions remain engagement scoped.

note: Sampling methods: Systematic Random with reproducible fractional interval/start; Stratified by monetary rank; Stratified Attribute by transaction direction. Populations reconcile to current TB control accounts. Confirmations: Bank, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Inventory and Legal, with engagement/FSLI, status, owner and evidence. Outstanding critical confirmation triggers a Pending Confirmation / Holding Letter simulation. Analytical Review records comparative source versions, analysis, conclusion and ISA 570 checklist. Findings expose balanced AJE authoring, independent technical review, management decision and current-TB reflection; SRM shows journal revisions, adjusted/unadjusted differences, SAD/PM comparison and significant estimates without double counting.
review: Confirm this flow against executed evidence.

title: Flow 4 — Opinion to archive
subtitle: STE Audit Management Tool · Functional Requirements v2.1

steps.heading: Partner approval
body: Approve current SRM and opinion basis after Manager clearance.

steps.heading: Release
body: Final 50% fee and exact five-part deliverable bundle.

steps.heading: Compliance
body: 60 calendar days file completion countdown, then ARCHIVED_READ_ONLY.

note: Assigned Partner approves the current Manager/SRM basis and selects a justified opinion. Compile exactly five final components; retain the unsigned LOR working copy separately until client management supplies the signed version. Final invoice is 50% of the pinned fee with one commercial obligation across reissued artifact revisions. Release locks uploads immediately. At report date plus 60 days, all mutations close; assigned Partner can lock early with recorded authority. Packaging verifies bytes independently and reports missing originals.

title: Module 4 — Reporting & Final Deliverables
subtitle: STE Audit Management Tool · Functional Requirements v2.1

steps.heading: Four opinions
body: Unmodified, Qualified, Adverse, Disclaimer.

steps.heading: Five-part bundle
body: Audit Report; Management Letter; Letter of Representation; Management Correspondences Audit Trail; Final Balance Fee Note.

steps.heading: Final fee and lock
body: Final 50% fee; ISA 230 60-day completion and frozen archive.

note: Opinions: Unqualified, Qualified, Adverse and Disclaimer with recorded rationale. Exactly five semantic deliverables: Independent Auditor Report & Audited Financial Statements; Management Letter; Letter of Representation; Management Correspondences Audit Trail; Final Balance Fee Note. Released bundle requires signed-LOR linkage and current source/review basis. Synthetic graphic seal/signature must be visibly labeled; no invented registration or verified legal stamp. Full inspection retains TB source history, workpapers, evidence, samples, review notes, decisions, AJEs, billing and timestamped system history. Original file bytes are digest-verified when available; unavailable originals remain explicit exceptions.
review: Confirm this flow against executed evidence.

title: Flow 5 — Time to practice analytics
subtitle: STE Audit Management Tool · Functional Requirements v2.1

steps.heading: Daily time
body: Record Engagement / FSLI hours with role charge-out rates.

steps.heading: Exact profitability
body: Total Engagement Cost = Σ(Logged Hours × Role Charge-Out Rate). Profitability = Contracted Audit Fee − Total Engagement Cost.

steps.heading: Missing inputs
body: Unknown rates produce Unknown profitability.

note: Daily time captures engagement, phase, hours, activity and effective charge rate; approval preserves the historical rate. Budget versus actual and utilization share staffing assumptions. Example fee 20,000 / WIP 25,000 gives 80% realization and 5,000 write-off; missing rate/cost/capacity shows Unknown. Scheduling changes must not silently reprice recorded WIP.
review: Confirm this flow against executed evidence.

title: Module 5 — Practice Management
subtitle: STE Audit Management Tool · Functional Requirements v2.1

steps.heading: Charge-out rates
body: QAR Partner 1,000; Manager 750; Senior 500; Associate 200.

steps.heading: Utilization
body: Actual logged hours and scheduled availability inform practice analytics.

steps.heading: Bookkeeping
body: Internal firm ledger, monthly TB, P&L, AR aging and Partner Withdrawals.

note: Standard QAR/hour rates: Engagement Partner 1,000; Audit Manager 750; Senior/Reviewer 500; Preparer/Staff 200. Capacity is counted once per person across phases, reduced by leave and checked for overlapping assignments. Issued/Paid invoices, effective receipt allocations and firm expense/withdrawal postings feed one balanced internal ledger projection for monthly TB, P&L and receivables; Draft invoices are excluded. Receipt reversals restore AR. Office rent, staff salaries, petty cash, other expenses and Partner withdrawals retain dated entries.

title: Client PBC experience
subtitle: STE Audit Management Tool · Functional Requirements v2.1

steps.heading: Requests
body: Client receives scoped PBC requests and uploads evidence.

steps.heading: Billing and Holding Letters
body: Invoices and receipts; only issued Holding Letters are visible.

steps.heading: Released deliverables
body: Only current released final deliverables; archive prevents uploads.

note: PBC statuses: Pending Upload; Under Review; Approved; Rejected / Re-upload Required. Invitation records the liaison and mandatory first-login password-reset simulation. Rejection requires a reason; replacement uploads retain prior version/digest and require review. Client finance sees only authorized engagement invoices/receipts, issued Holding Letters and released bundles. Unpaid advance invoice is visible after issuance. Reversed receipts are labeled historical with effective allocation amount. Draft/unreleased files and internal working papers remain hidden; release and archive lock uploads.

subtitle: STE Audit Management Tool · Functional Requirements v2.1

body: Execute five end-to-end flows and PBC client flow; responsive screenshots and focused rule tests.

steps.heading: Acceptance
body: Match persisted behavior, command guards, downstream outputs and this presentation.

steps.heading: Production boundary
body: Human sign-off and production integrations require separate evidence; no blanket compliance claim.

note: Trace each finding F01–F22 to changed source and executed regression evidence. React presentation and standalone Client_Requirements.html use the same 17-slide source and detailed notes. Browser checks verify operational forms and responsive widths, with unit checks for negative gates and stale references. Completion of local prototype behavior does not certify client acceptance, audit methodology or production security. Optional Cloudflare Worker/D1 saves isolated seven-day metadata snapshots; original bytes remain local, and mail, M365, password, signatures and payments are explicitly simulated.
